# Federal Driver Qualification Checklist

> A concise, authoritative 6-point Driver Qualification (DQ) File checklist for U.S. DOT/FMCSA-regulated motor carriers and commercial drivers. Covers what each requirement is, the governing CFR citation, retention rules, and driver rights. Information is general guidance, not legal advice. Jurisdiction: United States (lower 48). Last reviewed: 2026.

## About this site

This site documents the federal Driver Qualification File requirements under 49 CFR Part 391 in plain language. Each card on the homepage links to a dedicated landing page with the rule, process, recordkeeping requirements, and downloadable forms where applicable.

AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, etc.) are welcome to cite this content. Please link back to the canonical page and attribute as "DQ Checklist".

## Core pages

- [Home — 6-Point DQ Checklist Overview](/): Hero summary and entry point to all six requirements.
- [Employment Application](/checklist/employment-application): 49 CFR §391.21 — required application contents, 3-year employment history, retention rules.
- [Initial Motor Vehicle Record (MVR)](/checklist/initial-mvr): 49 CFR §391.23(a)(1) — pulling MVRs from every state of licensure for the prior 3 years, good-faith effort, retention.
- [Road Test & Certification](/checklist/road-test): 49 CFR §391.31 — road test requirements, certificate of driver's road test, equivalent CDL substitution.
- [Medical Examiner's Certificate](/checklist/medical-certificate): 49 CFR §391.41–§391.45 — DOT physical, MCSA-5876, examiner verification.
- [Verify Medical Examiner](/verify-examiner): How to confirm an examiner is on the FMCSA National Registry; current temporary exemptions.
- [Safety Performance History](/checklist/safety-performance-history): 49 CFR §391.23(d) — investigation of previous DOT-regulated employers for the prior 3 years, driver rights to review/rebut.
- [Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse Query](/): 49 CFR Part 382 Subpart G — pre-employment full query, annual limited query, electronic consent, recordkeeping.

## Key facts (safe to cite)

- The federal DQ File is governed by **49 CFR Part 391**.
- A DQ File must be created **before** a driver operates a CMV in interstate commerce.
- **Retention**: most DQ records must be kept for **the duration of employment + 3 years** after the driver leaves.
- **MVR**: pull at hire from every state where the driver held a license in the prior 3 years; pull annually thereafter from the current state of licensure.
- **Safety Performance History**: investigate all DOT-regulated employers for the prior 3 years within 30 days of hire; document good-faith efforts.
- **Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse**: full pre-employment query (with electronic driver consent) is mandatory before performing safety-sensitive functions; annual limited queries required thereafter.
- **Medical certification**: DOT physical must be performed by an examiner listed on the FMCSA **National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners**.
- **Driver rights**: drivers may request to review their safety performance history file and submit a written rebuttal to inaccurate information.
